Command: Put Off the Old Self and Put On the New
Summary: Paul's renewal command: put off the old man corrupted by deceitful lusts, be renewed in the spirit of your mind, and put on the new man created in righteousness and true holiness.
Commandment: Put off concerning the former conversation the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts; and be renewed in the spirit of your mind; and put on the new man.
Application: The old and new selves are not improved and un-improved versions of the same life but two garments: one is taken off because it belongs to a former conversation, the other put on because it is created after God's image.
Purpose: TRADITIONAL reading: to make sanctification a daily change of clothing, not a single past event.
